description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 22.08.2022 to 28.08.2022
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It establishes new official rates of exchange for various foreign currencies to be used for calculating customs duties and other charges. This constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement for international trade, falling squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for statutory instruments and regulatory matters.
